title: My stats
subtitle: Your games, your champions, your roles.
emptyRoster: This team has no players yet.
footnote: No global average is shown here: it is not available, and inventing one would be worse than doing without. Every figure is compared to your own other games or to your teammates.

locked.title: Link a Riot account to open this screen
locked.description: With no linked account there is nothing to compute: statistics are built from your games, and nothing tells us which ones are yours.

pending.title: Your Riot ID is waiting to be confirmed
pending.description: It is saved, but we could not confirm it with Riot yet. Collection will start as soon as we can.

waiting.title: Your data is on its way
waiting.description: The first pass walks your whole history. It is slow once, and only once.

window.label: Period
window.helper: Every figure on this screen covers that period.
window.bounded: Riot keeps about a thousand games per player: beyond that the history no longer exists, for anyone.

coverage.untracked: This account is not collected for itself yet: the known games are those where it met a player we track. The figures are exact, but partial.

delta.versusRest: {{delta}} against the rest of their pool ({{count}} game(s))

section.queuesHelper: Games played per mode. A win in normal draft is not a win in flex.
section.byQueueHelper: The mode excludes nothing: it separates what cannot be compared.
section.presenceHelper: Share of team games each player took part in.
section.trendHelper: Your win rate month by month, against your own average.
section.trendReference: Line: your average over the period ({{value}})
section.noMonth: Not enough history yet to draw a trend.

team.definition: A team game: at least {{count}} of the {{roster}} players on the roster, across all queues.
team.gamesHint: {{total}} found, {{undecided}} of them without a shared result
team.truncated: Only the most recent games are shown: the totals cover what is visible here.

games.ranksObserved: Ranks observed on {{date}} — Riot only serves the current rank.
games.rankHint: Average of ranked players ({{count}}); unranked players are not counted.

COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.short: No Riot account linked: nothing to compute.
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.title: No Riot account linked
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.description: Statistics are built from an account's games. Until a Riot ID is set, there are no games to attach.

INGESTION_EN_COURS.title: Collection is not finished
INGESTION_EN_COURS.description: The history is still being built. It is slow once, and only once: figures will appear as it goes.

AUCUNE_PARTIE.title: No game
AUCUNE_PARTIE.description: Everything is collected and there is nothing to count over this period. That is not a failure: widen the period to look further back.

EFFECTIF_INCOMPLET.title: Not enough Riot accounts on the roster
EFFECTIF_INCOMPLET.description: A team game needs at least four players present. While fewer than four members have a linked Riot account, no game can be recognised as a team game.

CONNECTEUR_INDISPONIBLE.title: Figures unavailable
CONNECTEUR_INDISPONIBLE.description: The Riot connector is not answering. Nothing is lost — but while it is silent we cannot claim anything, and showing zero would be wrong.

radar.title: Profile
radar.helper: Eight axes read against the chosen reference: the centre is its low end, the edge its high end.

note.team: Centre: the team's lowest, edge: its highest, over the same period as the dashboard.
note.met: As {{position}}, {{games}} game(s). Centre: 5th percentile of {{count}} direct opponents (at least {{min}} games each), edge: 95th.
note.league: In the {{position}} role, {{games}} game(s). Each axis is your percentile among {{count}} {{tier}} players in that role, patches {{patches}}: centre 0, edge 100.

empty.noGames: No Summoner's Rift game over the period.
empty.team: At least two players with statistics are needed.
empty.met: Not enough known direct opponents as {{position}} yet: ten are needed, with at least five games each. The reference grows with collection.
empty.leagueThin: No {{tier}} reference in the {{position}} role yet: it is computed daily from the ranked players collected.
empty.unranked: Unranked player: no tier to compare with.

scope.rift: Figures computed on Summoner's Rift (ranked, normals, Clash): ARAM and Arena would skew per-minute numbers.

players.filterHint: Click an avatar to keep only some players. A single player is shown in full, like My stats.
players.radarHint: Pick {{count}} players at most to see their radar profiles side by side.

detail.title: Game of {{date}}
detail.matchupsHelper: Our player against their counterpart. Rank gap in divisions (solo, else flex), and the lane state at 15 minutes.
detail.noTimeline: Timeline being collected: the 15-minute numbers will come with it.
detail.noMatchups: Members on both sides: no matchups.
detail.loadFailed: The game details could not be loaded.
detail.shortGame: Game over before 15 minutes: there is no 15-minute lane state.

opposition.title: How far the team wins
opposition.intro: Win rate by opponent level. Ranks are those observed at collection: for an old game, that is today's rank.
opposition.coverage: {{withRanks}} of {{games}} game(s) have ranks; median observation {{lag}} day(s) after the game.
opposition.byTierHelper: Solo, else flex; average of ranked opponents.
opposition.byGapHelper: Our average minus theirs, in divisions.
opposition.ceilingValue: Highest opponent tier held at 50% or more: {{tier}}
opposition.ceilingNone: No opponent tier held at 50% over {{count}} games or more.
opposition.ceilingHelper: At least {{count}} games in the tier.
opposition.byPositionHelper: Each member's direct counterpart. A lane won: more gold than them at 15 minutes.
opposition.pending: Opponent ranks are being collected: this section will fill in as collection goes.

refresh.done_one: New games requested for {{count}} player: they will appear as collection proceeds.
refresh.done_other: New games requested for {{count}} players: they will appear as collection proceeds.
refresh.tooSoon: An update was just requested: try again in a few minutes.

early.title: Early game, 0 to 15 min
early.helper: A gank is the jungler coming to an enemy lane. It is seen through a kill in the lane, or on each one-minute timeline frame: a visit without a kill between two frames is missed.
early.weakSummary: Our jungler played {{side}}; {{onWeak}} of {{total}} enemy gank(s) landed on the other side.
early.balancedSummary: Our jungler split their time between both sides.
early.noAnalysis: No early-game analysis: missing timeline, or unknown roles in this game.

team.helper: Over {{count}} team game(s) with an analysed timeline. Ganks without a kill are only seen on one-minute frames: they are undercounted.
team.none: No analysed team game over the period.
team.lanersHelper: Held: the targeted player did not die during the gank.
team.junglersHelper: Decisive: a kill without loss, or an objective on that side within 90 seconds.
team.sidesHelper: The side where they spent at least two more minutes. Weak side: the other one.

family.title: The detail, family by family
family.laningBasis: Differences against the direct opponent, over {{count}} game(s) with a timeline.

grade.level: {{tier}} level on the ladder scale: better than {{ladder}} of players in the {{position}} role, all ranks.
grade.inTier: {{rank}}th percentile of {{tier}} players in the {{position}} role ({{count}} players).
grade.inTierGame: {{rank}}th percentile of {{tier}} games in the {{position}} role.
grade.noLadder: Ladder scale not available yet: some tiers are missing from the sample.
grade.basis: Based on your games in the {{position}} role, compared with ranked players on patches {{patches}}.
grade.champion: {{rank}}th percentile of {{champion}} players in {{group}}, on their averages ({{count}} players with 5+ games).
grade.championFallback: Not enough {{champion}} players in {{group}} yet: compared with all {{tier}} players in the {{position}} role.
grade.team: Averaged over {{games}} game(s): {{rank}}th percentile of games at the same tier.

teamLevel.title: Our early game, graded
teamLevel.helper: Each team game with a timeline is placed among ranked games of the same tier; the grade is the average of those positions.
teamLevel.empty: No team game with a timeline in this period yet.
